item: audit 0.5.0 (read of PR #1490, L3): thirteen more destructive names gated to a person's gesture; the ratchet finds destructive names by the verb inside them
refs: R189; audit 0.5.0 A-023 A-024; PR #1490 read L3; 0.5.0 on main at eea913e7a, not yet tagged
summary: The destructive-name ratchet matched only names that BEGIN with delete|remove|secure|panic|uninstall|shutdown, so sgRemoveMember, kxRemoveTag, familyResetGroup, lawSetWatched(id,false), disableUnmanagedLanguages, jobCancel and excludeKeyword ran from an injected zero-click binding with no prompt. GESTURE_ONLY (a trusted click or Enter/Space, the guard removeAuthor/removeAnnotation/removeUserCalendar/removeDraftItem already had) now also holds: sgRemoveMember (DELETE a supergroup member), kxRemoveTag (remove a keyword tag), familyResetGroup (clears a family's overrides), lawSetWatched (stops tracking a law document; its resume half is also a click), disableUnmanagedLanguages (bulk-disables sources, reversible), jobCancel (cancels a download job), excludeKeyword (adds a keyword exclusion), plus the same-kind server cancels and removal found by the widened ratchet: cancelP0Validation, cancelPull, dumpFtsCancel, qualifyBulkCancel, releaseRunCancel, osmPickRemove. No new runtime mechanism and no change for a real click; every one is click-bound in the markup (the existing bound-to-click test holds that). The ratchet now finds a destructive name by the verbs inside it (delete, remove, reset, disable, cancel, exclude, clear, erase, wipe, purge, uninstall, shutdown, panic, secure) wherever they sit; a verb-named action must confirm in its own body, be in GESTURE_ONLY, or be on a short reasoned list of names that touch only this tab's view or this browser's localStorage (16 names, each with its reason, each checked to make no POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH request). Guard behaviour for a real user is unchanged: a real click or Enter/Space runs every name. The 16 view-only exemptions, each with its reason: _anClearSense (drops one word-sense pick from the open analysis); agExcludeBulk, agExcludeClear, agToggleExclude (browser-local calendar-feed exclusions in localStorage); bulkJobCancel (this tab's own queue and its own in-flight request); bulkJobClearDone (this tab's own queue list); cardResetTunable (puts a briefing-card input back to its default, saves nothing); clearIdxCompare (empties the open comparison selection); clearSrcFilters (empties the sources filter form and reloads the list); feedClearSeen (browser-local feed position marks); kbReset (browser-local keyboard shortcuts); onUninstallMode (reads the uninstall PLAN with a GET and shows it, the uninstall itself confirms); resetCustomPromptForm (empties an unsaved form); resetLlmPrompt (puts the default text in an editable box, nothing stored until Save); resetMap (the map's zoom box); resetUi (browser-local appearance). Stated limits: lawSetWatched carries no verb (its destructive half is an argument), so it is listed by name and a future name of that shape is not found; a view-only name that reaches the server through a helper function it calls is not seen; a trusted click is still not intent (injected overlay/accesskey); the generalised per-event allowlist (A-023/A-024) stays a proposal. Not browser-verified.
